can the lender charge me a prepayment pe.answer: Prepayment penalties are prohibited on floating-rate term loans granted to individual borrowers for purposes other than business.

citations.text: Clause 5.2: Prepayment penalties are prohibited on floating-rate term loans granted to individual borrowers for purposes other than business.

is it legal for the app to disburse fund.answer: All loan disbursements and repayments must be executed directly between the bank account of the borrower and the Regulated Entity without pass-through accounts.

citations.text: Clause 4.1: All loan disbursements and repayments must be executed directly between the bank account of the borrower and the Regulated Entity, without pass-through or pool accounts of any Lending Service Provider (LSP) or third party.

can the bank automatically increase my c.answer: Automatic increase in credit limit without explicit recorded consent of the borrower is strictly prohibited.

citations.text: Clause 4.2: Automatic increase in credit limit without explicit recorded consent of the borrower is strictly prohibited.

what is my right regarding cooling-off o.answer: The KFS shall clearly disclose cooling-off / look-up period during which the borrower can exit the loan without penalty.

citations.text: Clause 3.2: The KFS shall clearly disclose cooling-off / look-up period during which the borrower can exit the loan without penalty.

can the lender capitalize penal interest.answer: Penal charges for delayed payments shall be reasonable, transparent, and non-capitalized (i.e., interest shall not be charged on penal charges).
